OVERALL VERDICT
"A credible, technically tidy AI portfolio with strong positioning, but it needs far more proof, crawl resilience, and conversion clarity to compete for attention."

The page does a solid job of positioning Tushar Kapoor as an "Applied AI Engineer" and the metadata is unusually well handled for a personal portfolio. However, the experience appears heavily JavaScript-dependent, the visible above-the-fold copy is sparse, and the page currently asks visitors to trust claims like "proven in production-style builds" without enough concrete evidence, artifacts, or case-study depth. As a portfolio, it is promising; as a discoverable, convincing lead-generation asset, it is not yet persuasive enough.

71
SCORE
SEO Audit
13 / 16 ON-PAGE CHECKS PASSING

This page clears Google's basic technical requirements for indexing: it returns HTTP 200, is indexable, uses HTTPS, and has meaningful rendered content (657 words). On-page fundamentals are better than average, with a 35-character title, a 156-character meta description, one clear H1, self-referencing canonical, Open Graph/Twitter tags, and 3 JSON-LD objects. The biggest SEO weaknesses are crawl resilience and discoverability: the page is heavily JS-dependent (raw text only 6 words), and both robots.txt and sitemap.xml are missing.

SEO ISSUES
Content is JavaScript-dependent
WARNING

The raw HTML exposes only 1% of the rendered text (6 of 657 words). Crawlers or link previewers that do not execute JavaScript see a near-empty page.

Fix: Server-render or pre-render primary content (SSR/SSG) so the core copy is present in the initial HTML response, not injected only after hydration.
No robots.txt found
INFO

A robots.txt was not found at the site root. Crawlers cannot discover crawl rules or a sitemap reference.

Fix: Add a /robots.txt that allows crawling of public pages and includes a `Sitemap:` line pointing to your sitemap.xml.
No valid sitemap.xml found
INFO

A valid XML sitemap was not found at /sitemap.xml. Sitemaps help search engines discover and prioritize your pages.

Fix: Generate a sitemap.xml (a `<urlset>` of your public URLs) and reference it from robots.txt.
Physical address without LocalBusiness schema
INFO

The page shows a physical address but has no LocalBusiness (or subtype) JSON-LD, so search engines cannot reliably associate the location with the business.

Fix: Add LocalBusiness JSON-LD with name, address, telephone, geo, and openingHours to strengthen local-SEO eligibility.
Render core content without JavaScript
WARNING

The page is strongly JS-dependent: rawWordCount is 6 while renderedWordCount is 657, with only 1% of rendered text present in the raw HTML. Google can render JavaScript, but Google Search Essentials still favor making important content directly accessible.

Fix: Ship the hero copy, project headings, bio, and key descriptive text in the initial HTML via static generation or server rendering. Keep JavaScript for enhancement, not for delivering the page's primary meaning.
Add a robots.txt file
WARNING

robots.txt is missing and returns 404. This does not block indexing by itself, but it removes a standard discovery and control point for search engines.

Fix: Publish /robots.txt with a simple allow
